cohort: The study included 68 pregnant women with overt or gestational diabetes, 36 women with physiological pregnancies (controls), and a retrospective group of 67 women with unspecified conditions.
finding: In 60% of pregnant women with GDM, pregnancy and childbirth were associated with maternal and/or fetal complications.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery is considered optimal for pregnant women with corrected diabetes, an optimal insulin regimen, rational diet therapy, and no signs of diabetic fetopathy.
